title: Tensorial Mode Stability of Kerr–de Sitter Spacetimes
exact_target: Prove geometric tensorial mode stability for every subextremal Kerr--de Sitter parameter choice.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006049 (OWR-14298591-013). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/36, pp. 2033--2112. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Scalar mode stability or a gauge-fixed result in a small-rotation or small-cosmological-parameter range does not cover the entire requested tensorial range.
